name: encryption-strategy
description: Design encryption strategy covering at-rest, in-transit, in-use, and end-to-end. Per data category + location: algorithm / protocol / key length / key management / rotation cadence. Key hierarchy (KMS / HSM / envelope encryption). Cipher suite selection, certificate management, PFS, cryptographic agility. Regulatory alignment (FIPS, PCI, GDPR). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
